data.name: Canva: Export Design
data.description: Export a Canva design to a file format (pdf, png, jpg, svg, etc.).
data.instructions:
Export an existing Canva design to a downloadable file.

Specify the design ID and desired export format (pdf, png, jpg).

**Inputs:**
- {design_id}: The Canva design ID to export
- {format}: Export format — "pdf", "png", or "jpg"

**Output:** {result} contains the export download URL.
